title: Mission Control
launchDescription: Multi-Agent Orchestration Hub — Orchestrate multiple AI agents simultaneously with full visibility on reasoning, files, and token consumption.
noAgents: No agents yet. Add your first agent to get started.
selectAgentForTree: Select an agent to view its decision tree

featureHints.featureMultiAgent: Run several agents side by side, each with its own task.
featureHints.featureModelMixing: Pick a provider and a model per agent: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama…
featureHints.featureDecisionTree: Follow why each agent chose its next step.
featureHints.featureLiveView: Tokens, cost and events as they happen.

compose.intro: Describe the work, pick a spec or a template: Mission Control suggests a crew across the providers you choose, and a cheaper one if you set a budget.

auto.label: From the description
auto.hint: The work decides: its kind, size, domains and tests.

bug_fix.label: Bug fix
bug_fix.hint: A debugger, a coder, a tester when the project has tests.

new_feature.label: New feature
new_feature.hint: An architect, coders by size, a reviewer, a tester.

refactor_module.label: Refactor module
refactor_module.hint: An architect, coders by size, a critical reviewer.

incident_response.label: Incident response
incident_response.hint: A flagship debugger, a coder, a reviewer, a post-mortem writer.

compose.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Fix the crash when the login API times out
compose.providersHint: Each role goes to the first provider that has a capable model of its tier.
compose.refine: Ask a fast model of the first provider for a second opinion
compose.degraded: Over budget: the full crew costs ${{full}}. Proposed crew: ${{proposed}} (saves ${{delta}}, expected quality {{quality}} %).
compose.refused: Budget too low: even the smallest crew needs ${{cost}} and {{tokens}} tokens. Raise the budget or start from a smaller template.

warnings.vague_input: The description is too vague: a generic crew is suggested. Add details or pick a template.
warnings.provider_unsupported: {{provider}} cannot run an agent on its own here and was left out.
warnings.role_unserved: No chosen provider has a model fit for the {{role}} role (tool use or context window).
warnings.unpriced_models: Some models have no price in the catalog: their cost is not counted.
warnings.hints_unusable: The fast model's answer could not be used: the heuristics decided alone.
warnings.refine_failed: {{provider}} did not answer the second opinion: the heuristics decided alone.

errors.invalid_providers: Pick at least one provider (eight at most).
errors.invalid_budget: The budget must be a positive number (a whole number of tokens).
errors.invalid_spec: The spec cannot be found in this project.
errors.no_provider: None of the chosen providers can run an agent on its own.
errors.no_capable_model: None of the chosen providers has a model fit for these roles.
